paras: Garrett's reed warbler (Acrocephalus musae), sometimes called the Society Islands reed warbler or Forster's reed-warbler, is an extinct species of reed warbler in the family Acrocephalidae. It was endemic to Raiatea and Huahine in the Society Islands.
It was formerly considered a subspecies of the Tahiti reed warbler.
Acrocephalus musae garretti - Huahine Island, extinct (19th century?)
Acrocephalus musae musae - Raiatea Island, extinct (19th century?)
